query: SELECT 'frpm' t, COUNT(*) n FROM frpm UNION ALL SELECT 'satscores', COUNT(*) FROM satscores UNION ALL SELECT 'schools', COUNT(*) FROM schools;
result: frpm 9986 rows, satscores 2269 rows, schools 17686 rows. Three tables only; no declared foreign keys in the schema.
validation_method: read-only connection, row count enumeration

query: SELECT "Academic Year", COUNT(*) n FROM frpm GROUP BY 1;
result: A single value, 2014-2015, on all 9986 rows. The SAT file has no year column.
validation_method: distinct value enumeration

query: SELECT MIN("Percent (%) Eligible Free (K-12)"), MAX("Percent (%) Eligible Free (K-12)"), MIN("Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)"), MAX("Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)"), SUM(CASE WHEN "Percent (%) Eligible Free (K-12)">1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) FROM frpm;
result: Free rate ranges 0.00176056338028169 to 1.0; FRPM rate ranges 0.00220507166482911 to 1.0; 0 rows above 1.0. Values are fractions, not 0-100 percentages.
validation_method: min/max and out-of-range count

query: SELECT SUM(ABS("Percent (%) Eligible Free (K-12)" - "Free Meal Count (K-12)"/"Enrollment (K-12)") > 0.0000001), SUM(ABS("Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)" - "FRPM Count (K-12)"/"Enrollment (K-12)") > 0.0000001), SUM("Enrollment (K-12)"=0) FROM frpm;
result: 0 mismatches for the free-meal rate, 0 mismatches for the FRPM rate, 0 rows with zero enrollment. The same test on the Ages 5-17 scope also returned 0 mismatches and 0 zero enrollments.
validation_method: tolerance-based recomputation of each rate from its count and enrollment columns

query: SELECT t, L, COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT 'frpm' t, LENGTH(CDSCode) L FROM frpm UNION ALL SELECT 'schools', LENGTH(CDSCode) FROM schools UNION ALL SELECT 'satscores', LENGTH(cds) FROM satscores) GROUP BY t, L;
result: frpm 14 characters on all 9986 rows; schools 14 characters on all 17686 rows; satscores 13 characters on 211 rows and 14 characters on 2058 rows.
validation_method: length distribution per table

query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM satscores s JOIN schools sc ON sc.CDSCode = s.cds; and the same join with CASE WHEN LENGTH(s.cds)=13 THEN '0'||s.cds ELSE s.cds END
result: Direct equality matches 2058 of 2269 records. Prefixing a zero to the 13-character values matches 2269 of 2269. The 211 unmatched records are exactly the rows whose shortened identifier begins with a county code in the 01 to 09 range.
validation_method: join cardinality comparison under two reconciliation rules

query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM frpm WHERE SUBSTR(CDSCode,8,7)='0000000'; SELECT COUNT(*) FROM schools WHERE SUBSTR(CDSCode,8,7)='0000000';
result: FRPM has 45 such rows and the school directory has 1369. All 45 FRPM rows join to a directory row, and all of them have blank School Type, blank Educational Option Type and blank Charter School (Y/N). All 1369 directory rows have a null School column. 16317 of 17686 directory rows are school level.
validation_method: row identification by identifier segment, joined attribute inspection

query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT SUBSTR(CDSCode,1,2) seg, COUNT(DISTINCT County) dc FROM schools GROUP BY seg HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT County)>1); and the same grouped on SUBSTR(CDSCode,1,7) with COUNT(DISTINCT District).
result: No two-character county segment maps to more than one County name and no seven-character county-district segment maps to more than one District name; both violation counts are 0. There are 1430 distinct seven-character district prefixes and 58 distinct two-character county prefixes.
validation_method: functional dependency check on identifier segments

query: SELECT District, COUNT(DISTINCT County) c FROM schools GROUP BY District HAVING c>1;
result: District labels repeat across counties: Jefferson Elementary appears in 3 counties, and Central Union High, Fairfax Elementary, Hope Elementary, Junction Elementary, Lake Elementary, Lakeside Union Elementary, Liberty Elementary, Mountain View Elementary and Ocean View each appear in 2.
validation_method: group-by collision detection

query: SELECT CASE WHEN NumTstTakr=0 THEN '0' WHEN NumTstTakr<=10 THEN '1-10' ELSE '>10' END band, COUNT(*), SUM(AvgScrRead IS NULL), SUM(NumGE1500 IS NULL) FROM satscores GROUP BY band;
result: Band 0: 218 rows, all 218 with null reading score and null 1500-count. Band 1-10: 378 rows, all with null scores. Band above 10: 1673 rows, none null. Maximum test taker count with a null score is 10; minimum with a reported score is 11.
validation_method: banded null-rate enumeration and boundary search

query: SELECT SUM((AvgScrRead IS NULL)<>(NumGE1500 IS NULL)) FROM satscores;
result: 0 mismatches: the 1500-or-above count is null exactly when the section average scores are null, so the two are suppressed together.
validation_method: exclusive-or count across the two nullability patterns

query: SELECT MIN(AvgScrRead),MAX(AvgScrRead),MIN(AvgScrMath),MAX(AvgScrMath),MIN(AvgScrWrite),MAX(AvgScrWrite), SUM(NumGE1500>NumTstTakr), MAX(NumGE1500) FROM satscores;
result: Reading 308 to 653, mathematics 289 to 699, writing 312 to 671; all within the 200 to 800 per-section scale. 0 records where the 1500-or-above count exceeds the test taker count. Maximum 1500-or-above count is 5837.
validation_method: range check against the documented SAT scale and denominator consistency check

query: SELECT rtype, COUNT(*), SUM(AvgScrRead IS NULL), SUM(NumTstTakr=0) FROM satscores GROUP BY rtype; plus a join to the directory checking which grain each record matches.
result: rtype D has 520 rows and rtype S has 1749. All 520 D records join only to directory rows whose school segment is 0000000, and all 1749 S records join to school-level rows; 0 records disagree between the record type and the directory grain.
validation_method: grain cross-check between record type and the identifier's school segment

source: california_schools sqlite, enroll12 versus K-12 enrollment
query: SELECT s.cds, s.enroll12, f."Enrollment (K-12)" FROM satscores s JOIN frpm f ON f.CDSCode = CASE WHEN LENGTH(s.cds)=13 THEN '0'||s.cds ELSE s.cds END LIMIT 5; plus SUM(NumTstTakr>enroll12) and the mean ratio.
result: For CDS 01100170109835 the SAT file reports 62 enrolled against 1087 in the FRPM file; other pairs show the same order of magnitude gap. 30 records report more test takers than twelfth-grade enrollment, 5 report zero enrollment, and the mean ratio of test takers to twelfth-grade enrollment is approximately 0.395.
validation_method: paired value inspection and ratio distribution

query: SELECT SUM("FRPM Count (K-12)" < "Free Meal Count (K-12)"), SUM("FRPM Count (K-12)" = "Free Meal Count (K-12)"), COUNT(*) FROM frpm;
result: 0 rows where the FRPM count is smaller than the free meal count; 578 rows where the two counts are equal out of 9986.
validation_method: subset violation count and equality count

query: Group-by enumerations of frpm.'School Type' against schools.SOCType and frpm.'District Type' against schools.DOCType.
result: FRPM School Type has 18 distinct values against 21 for the directory SOC type; FRPM District Type has 8 against 12 for the directory DOC type. Shared values such as Elementary Schools (Public) and Unified School District match exactly; the directory adds categories the FRPM file never uses, such as Adult Education Centers, ROC/ROP and Community College District.
validation_method: value-domain comparison across tables

query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM frpm f JOIN schools sc ON sc.CDSCode=f.CDSCode WHERE f."County Name"<>sc.County OR f."District Name"<>sc.District;
result: 0 mismatches across all 9986 joined rows, so the county and district labels are identical in both tables wherever a CDS code is shared.
validation_method: join-based mismatch count

query: SELECT f."Charter School (Y/N)", sc.Charter, COUNT(*) FROM frpm f JOIN schools sc ON sc.CDSCode=f.CDSCode GROUP BY 1,2;
result: Both blank 45, both 0 in 8771 rows, both 1 in 1163 rows, FRPM 0 against directory 1 in 3 rows, FRPM 1 against directory 0 in 4 rows. Agreement on 9934 of 9986 joined rows.
validation_method: cross-tabulation of the two flags on the shared key

query: SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN sc.GSserved = f."Low Grade"||'-'||f."High Grade" THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), COUNT(*) FROM schools sc JOIN frpm f ON f.CDSCode=sc.CDSCode WHERE sc.GSserved IS NOT NULL AND sc.GSserved<>'';
result: 8381 exact matches out of 9935 comparable rows. The most common spans are K-5 (2465), K-6 (1958), 9-12 (1726) and K-8 (979).
validation_method: reconstruction of the directory range string from the FRPM boundary columns

query: SELECT StatusType, COUNT(*) FROM schools GROUP BY 1; and the same joined to frpm.
result: Active 11708, Closed 4518, Merged 1448, Pending 12 in the directory. FRPM-joined rows are Active 9846 and Closed 140; no Merged or Pending rows appear in the FRPM file. ClosedDate is populated on 5694 directory rows.
validation_method: status distribution and join coverage by status

query: SELECT SUM(EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM frpm f WHERE f.CDSCode=CASE WHEN LENGTH(s.cds)=13 THEN '0'||s.cds ELSE s.cds END)), COUNT(*) FROM satscores s; and the reverse direction from frpm.
result: 1782 of 2269 SAT records match an FRPM row, and 1782 of 9986 FRPM rows have a matching SAT record. 9941 of 9986 FRPM rows match a school-level directory row.
validation_method: bidirectional join coverage counts

query: SELECT SUM("Percent (%) Eligible Free (K-12)" IS NULL), SUM("Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)" IS NULL), SUM("Enrollment (K-12)" IS NULL), SUM("Free Meal Count (K-12)" IS NULL) FROM frpm;
result: 56 null free-meal rates, 50 null FRPM rates, 0 null enrollments, 56 null free meal counts.
validation_method: null count enumeration

query: SELECT "2013-14 CALPADS Fall 1 Certification Status", COUNT(*) FROM frpm GROUP BY 1;
result: A single value, 1, on all 9986 rows. The column carries no discriminating information in this snapshot.
validation_method: distinct value enumeration

query: SELECT MIN("Enrollment (K-12)"), MAX("Enrollment (K-12)"), AVG("Enrollment (K-12)") FROM frpm;
result: Minimum 1, maximum 5333, mean approximately 620.83, with no null values. The separate Ages 5-17 enrollment column is populated for the same rows at a different scope.
validation_method: range and mean enumeration with null check
